Why I started this

I was always too busy enjoying the party to take photos

I love kids' parties, but I'd always get home with barely any photos. Hiring a photographer felt complicated, so I started a selfie booth: guests snap themselves, and you get to enjoy your own party.

— An, Stratford-upon-Avon

Questions

Good to know

Are you insured?

Yes, £5m public liability with Chiswell. I can send the certificate to your venue.

How much space is needed?

About 2m × 2m near a plug socket.

Is it good for young children?

Yes, it was made with kids' parties in mind.

Are the photos edited?

Every photo gets a photographer-style finish as it's taken, and 50 of the best get a further edit after the event.

Can it be personalised?

Yes. The welcome screen and photos can show your names, date and colours, or your own design.

Do you work with venues?

Yes, venues are welcome to get in touch.
